text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, everyone.
Gratitude for supporting Team <Ascella>
throughout spring.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To Rhein Kraft and Cesario,
proud G1 victors――Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Kraft&Cesario
text_block_list.text: Cheers—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario, feels like dream!
Grand party just for us.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together in autumn too!
At 『Shuuka Sho』!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Agreed, Kraft!
Rivals once more on that turf.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll give it my all! 『Oka Sho』,
『NHK Mile C』, then seize 『Shuuka Sho』――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Unorthodox Triple Crown"!
Carving brand-new Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Unorthodox……Triple Crown……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I see.
Kraft's journey seeks more than two
crowns.
Eyes set ahead on new Unorthodox Triple
Crown……)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!
Unorthodox Triple Crown?! You serious,
Kraft?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eep?! Ah... Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, I haven't even debuted yet...
As expected of Kraft~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Unorthodox Double Crown was badass enough,
but Triple Crown too?
That's true champ style!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh!
Gotta pull off something awesome like that
too!
Maybe I'll ask Gim-senpai for tips!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
yes! We'll do our best so Vodka-san gets
fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Right, Cesario?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Kraft is already charging toward Unorthodox
Triple Crown.
But what about me?
Shuuka Sho is race I've always dreamed of,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(At Shuuka Sho...
what can only Oaks winner like me accomplish?
Since Triple Tiara is impossible now...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong?
You've been staring at Cesario.
Nothing, just worried about her.
Nothing, just worried about her.

There was something I wanted to discuss with
Cesario. But...

She seemed cheerful at first,
then suddenly looked conflicted. Why?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Whew... feel completely drained...
Need breath of fresh air...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(......
Where should I go from here...?)
Cesario, there you are.
Cesario, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...
What's wrong? Looking down.
What's wrong? Looking down.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I've been troubled. Now spring ends,
Kraft's path and mine have split...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now split, I don't know where to head...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Kraft chose to blaze new Tiara trail.
New route via NHK Mile Cup—
claiming Unorthodox Double Crown.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now aiming for Triple Crown.
Truly new frontier for Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile,
experiencing Symboli Kris S's might taught
me much. Winning Oaks proved my strength.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yet after this,
I have no goal like Kraft's Unorthodox Triple
Crown. Having lost Oka Sho,
Triple Tiara is gone...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Like this,
feel unworthy standing beside Kraft... Plus,
"that umamusume" dominates Classic Triple
Crown talk right now.

Triple Crown route...
"That umamusume," huh...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And undefeated Double Crown winner is
born!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Historic moment!
Come autumn Kyoto at Kikka Sho,
another legend may arise!

During spring,
certain umamusume conquered Satsuki Sho and
Japan Derby. Both legs of Classic Triple Crown,
Tiara's counterpart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to—leave lasting legacy without losing!
Unshakable proof, for sake of Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: But... how?
Cesario was lost. Time to show her.

Kept letter in breast pocket,
waiting right moment. All for this—

Cesario,
look at this letter.
Might be answer you seek.

Cesario,
look at this letter.
Might be answer you seek.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —?! This is...!
Invitation. To—
Invitation. To—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: American Oaks... Truly... for me...?

American Oaks. US West Coast G1.
Major stage gathering Classic-class Tiara
umamusume worldwide.

Unexpected,
yet tremendous honor.
Cesario's Oaks run caught American racing
association's eye.

Many domestic umamusume challenged overseas
G1s. Seeking the Pearl claimed European G1
first, but...

No umamusume ever took US G1 crown.
Not even "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Tremendous... honor,
truly. Victory would rival Kraft's feats.
However—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If I recall,
in last year's American Oaks...
our nation's top umamusume fell short,
right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even that "Genius" trainer-runner pair placed
2nd...
Yes, true...
Yes, true...

Cesario spoke truth.
Even Strongest Duo couldn't win.
Does she possess strength and will to surpass
them...?
I believe—challenge is worth taking.
I believe—challenge is worth taking.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Worth it... But can I really...?
You're not alone. We stand together.
You're not alone. We stand together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

Meant every word.
Not just Cesario's battle—
Team <Ascella>'s battle.

Never let her fight alone.
Challenge demanding entire team united.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
If you believe in me that much,
then with honor!

Hesitant at first,
Cesario accepted invitation. Spring closed.
And backing that resolve—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Sweep Tosho!
Sweep Tosho! Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
11th favorite defies odds to seize Takarazuka
Kinen! Tiara umamusume are fierce!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuuuu~, Legerica Paprika, Radimarihoo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How's that? See that-?!
Nothing's impossible for great witch like
me♪

Ultimate magic cast.
First Tiara route umamusume Takarazuka Kinen
win in 39 years. No ordinary victory.

Shocking triumph defeating reigning champ
Tap Dance City and Autumn Senior Triple
Crown holder Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san did it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Beat such formidable rivals... won...
Everyone in Tiara line creates miracle after
miracle... Then me too!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, no more hesitation.
I believe in my power.
I'll take challenge.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Claim unprecedented American G1 glory!
At American Oaks!

Yeah,
let's seize it!
Historic milestone for Japan!

Yeah,
let's seize it!
Historic milestone for Japan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

Eyes set on America.
Cesario's fiercest trial begins,
chasing history.
